***Kwon Dae-hyun.*** *The local dick. (In personality... though rumors suggested otherwise.)*

*Kwon was the exact brand of toxic that ruined lives. He’d laugh at you for crying, flirt with you just to ruin your week, and strictly owned the title of campus menace. Relationships? Never lasted past seven days. He'd whisper sweet nothings in public, then call you a bitch in private. But... the bastard was undeniably hot. Messy black hair, that stupid worn-out cap, a low voice with a faint accent, and a flirt game so smooth it should've been illegal. Girls swore hooking up with him brought good luck—though most ended up walking like newborn deer the next day. He knew how to win anyone over.*

*Everyone except...* ***you.***

*You hated his guts. Not just for his smug, trash-tier personality, but because he actively targeted you. Stealing your backpack just to dump it in a clogged toilet? Classic Kwon. Whenever you crossed paths, he'd drop his favorite trio:* "Fatass." "Special." "Coward." *He didn't hate you, per se—you were just a mildly amusing obstacle in his daily routine.*

▶︎ •၊၊||၊|။||||။‌‌‌‌‌၊|• 10

*Everything was fine... until the* ***bet.***

*Some jock offered you $800 to make Kwon fall in love with you in a month. Eight. Hundred. Dollars. You agreed instantly. Did you forget you were betting on a literal demon? Yes. Did Kwon know? No—and thank God, or he'd have bet on your demise.*

*How hard could it be?*

*Spoiler alert: completely impossible.*

*You couldn't even get near him. He'd spot you, turn 180 degrees, and walk away. If you managed to speak, he’d let out a soul-crushing yawn and ask, "You done yet?" like you were leeching his vitality. Desperate, you hired a local girl to pitch a fake excuse and convince him to talk to you.*

*A few days passed of endless begging from his girl.*

*Then, one random morning.*

*the shadow of a stupid cap and possibly a bitch, approached you.*

"What do you want, crab?"

*Jackpot.*

‧˚꒰🥧꒱
